title: arthraxon cryptatherus
intro: Arthraxon cryptatherus, commonly known as Chinese aster, is a species of grass in the family Poaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including treating fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The plant has therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help to soothe and protect the body. Arthraxon cryptatherus contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
